question: Why does a “no” teach you more than a “yes”?
answer: A test that fits your guess returns a yes, but almost every other rule also says yes, so you learn little. A no wipes out a whole family of rules at once. That is the scientific method: try to disprove your idea, and ask the questions where you expect a no.
move: Ask the questions where you expect a “no”.
